rules: Calls 180-460 days out. Chosen: delta 0.75-0.85, bid > 0, expiry nearest 274 days, then highest open interest. ok = open interest >= 100 and spread <= 8% of mid; thin = fails either; none = no qualifying contract. option_alt (when thin) = most liquid call with delta 0.6-0.9. Delta is Black-Scholes, rate 0.04, dividends ignored; iv from the chain when 0.05-3, else solved from the mid. Bid and ask both 0: quote stale, lastPrice is never used for prices. fits_slot from ask x 100: up to SLOT_USD true, up to SLOT_STRETCH stretch, above it false.
